description: This file defines the EmployeeAddress class, which extends CombinedDisplayField, responsible for representing employee address details in a report display context. It specifies fields related to employee address components and provides methods to retrieve the associated DTO class, address fields, and entity aliases.

classes.name: EmployeeAddress
classes.description: A class that encapsulates employee address display fields for reporting, extending CombinedDisplayField.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with employee addresses.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields related to employee address details.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides entity alias mappings used in query building for report generation.
